title: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving

translated_title: 目标之前的记忆：预历史记忆在人形机器人移动操作中的作用
translated_abstract: 动态场景中的人形机器人移动操作是非马尔可夫的：当物体发生变化或被遮挡时线索会消失，或者当机器人转身行走时物体会离开视野，而全身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略却只能看到当前时刻。我们提出了WholeBodyMem，一种物体引导的感知记忆，它保存了机器人在执行目标之前所看到的物体事件的历史。SAM3负责跟踪任务物体，其事件以因果方式在自适应预算内选择关键帧，动作专家通过交叉注意力机制将这些关键帧与编码外观、几何和时间的物体标记一起读取。我们还贡献了HuMeGo，一个包含六个仿真任务和六个真实世界Unitree G1任务的人形机器人记忆基准。通过保留正确的帧而非更多的帧，WholeBodyMem超越了无记忆和均匀记忆的基线方法，将其基础策略的成功率在仿真中从29.1%提升至72.6%，在真实机器人上从36.7%提升至88.3%，同时还改善了……
tldr: 提出物体引导的感知记忆机制WholeBodyMem，利用SAM3跟踪的物体事件因果选择关键帧，使人形机器人全身VLA策略能够记住行动前的物体历史，从而在非马尔可夫动态场景中大幅提升成功率（仿真中29.1%提升至72.6%，真实机器人上36.7%提升至88.3%），并发布了HuMeGo人形机器人记忆基准。
en_tdlr: WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that causally selects keyframes from pre-goal object events tracked by SAM3, enables whole-body VLA policies to retain object history in non-Markovian dynamic scenes, boosting humanoid loco-manipulation success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on a real robot, alongside the new HuMeGo benchmark.
